title: [Master]-Non-Deductible Reverse-Charge VAT Correction Is Posted to Purchase VAT Account Instead of Payment Discount Account.
summary: When posting non-deductible reverse-charge VAT corrections with payment discounts, the system now correctly retrieves the GL account from General Posting Setup instead of posting to the purchase VAT account.
key_points: Fixed GL account selection for non-deductible VAT corrections when payment discounts are involved
GL account is now sourced from General Posting Setup configuration
Prevents incorrect posting to purchase VAT account
Affects multiple localizations including W1, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, IT, NA, NO, RU, and APAC
Includes updated test case for non-deductible VAT payment discount scenario
quote: GL Account is now called from the General Posting Setup instead when Pmt Discount is Involved.
